items.title: Staff of Secretariat Department
items.description: Managed organizational documents, including letters, proposals, reports, certificates, and supporting records, ensuring accurate and well-organized documentation.
achievements: Handled outgoing letter requests and certificate numbering, maintaining accurate records and supporting timely document processing.
Organized and maintained document archives throughout the organizational period for easy and reliable access to records.
Coordinated documentation needs with members and related departments to ensure complete documents and smooth administrative processes.
